author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to learn more about the ambitious co-op, tactical objective-based extraction shooter ‘DarkSwarm’.

Developed in UE5 by the small but ambitious team at Bitfire Games, ‘DarkSwarm’ features procedurally generated levels, loads of weaponry, and finely tuned gameplay designed for its drop-in/drop-out multiplayer. 

We caught up with Bitfire’s CEO and Co-Founder Hans Oxmond to find out how the indie team is bringing its bold brand of colorful co-op combat and accessible multiplayer to life. 

Plus, we discuss the role that key UE5 features, optimization tools, and source code access are playing during development.

Find out more about creating games in Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com/uses/indie-games
